info.text:
# SteamWorld Dig 2

## What does randomization do to this game?

Every reward in the game becomes a location, and the tool upgrades, blueprints, artifacts and cogs are shuffled into the
item pool. Shops sell items from the multiworld for in-game money, so digging and selling ore still matter.

## What is the goal?

Defeat Rosie. The Reactor door requires the Device items. By default that means all 4, or 3 with `Generators Required` set to Vanilla.

## What items and locations get randomized?

### The possible location checks include the following:

- Cog containers (77)
- Artifacts (42)
- Upgrade podiums (10)
- Generators (4)
- The workbench's upgrade slots (42)
- Trader Carson's wares (7) and Clifford's blueprint (1)
- The Cartographer's rewards (8)
- The Yonker brothers' blueprints (3)

These are optional:

- Teleporters (25)
- The Trials and their Proof of Completion (1)
- Orb containers:
  - Health (23)
  - Light (34)
  - Mixed (23)
  - Super (5)
- Secret Areas (85) 
- Mini Secrets (35)

### The items that are randomized are:

- Hook Shot
- Sprint Hydraulics
- Tool upgrades
  - Pickaxe
  - Backpack 
  - Lamp
  - Armor
  - Water Tank
  - Pressure Bomb
  - Jackhammer
  - Jet Engine
- Cog mod blueprints
  - Grenade Launcher
  - Long-Range Grappler
  - Ignition Axe
  - Ultra Composite Armor
  - Ramjet Vigor
  - ThreeForce Grenade
  - Deathplosions
  - Thrillseeker's Tale
  - Blood Quest
  - Gaze of Odin
  - Criss-Cross Combustion
  - Core Diversity
  - Pocket of Freyr
  - More-Hoarder's Map
  - Sharpened Edge
  - Aquatic Regenesis
  - Sigillum Caelum et Infernum
    - Opens the Trials when `Include Trials` is on
- The four Devices
  - Doom
  - Devastation
  - Disaster
  - Destruction
- The 43 artifacts
- Upgrade Cogs (up to 84)

## What other changes are made to the game?

- The opening cutscene is skipped
- Items you receive wait until you've fallen into the Temple, so nothing can skip the earthquake
- The Reactor door waits for the required Device items
  - Breaking a generator is a location and no longer opens the door
- Vectron is skipped
  - A bomb through the teleporter room's ceiling opens the way to the Jet Engine podium
- Quests can no longer lock you out
  - Fen's quests are side quests
- El Machino's welcome speech always plays when walking into the trigger on the left
- Rosie's Storage opens once its quest is done (in case you skipped Rosie's first interaction)
- Ignition Axe damage against the Priest Boss (guarding the Ignition Axe podium) is normalized

## What does another world's item look like in SteamWorld Dig 2?

Cog containers look the same as usual, and an artifact's spot holds what looks like an Upgrade Cog. A banner tells you what you found in these and on podiums once you take it. Shop slots show the Archipelago logo with the item and who it's for unless `Show Shop Items` is off.

## What if I get stuck?

You might find yourself stuck in a cave after using a podium, and Self-Destruct sends you back to the podium. Instead, return to the main menu and reload the save, which will send you back to the entrance.

tutorials.text:
# SteamWorld Dig 2 Setup Guide

## Required Software

- SteamWorld Dig 2, the Steam or GOG version
- [Archipelago](https://github.com/ArchipelagoMW/Archipelago/releases)
    - 0.6.8 or later
- `swd2.apworld` from the [releases page](https://github.com/ClTYOFEVlL/SWD2-Archipelago/releases)

## Recommended Software

- [Universal Tracker](https://github.com/FarisTheAncient/Archipelago/releases), to see what's in logic
    - You don't need the YAML for the tracker to work

## Installation

1. Double click `swd2.apworld` to install it, or move it to the `custom_worlds` folder in your Archipelago install
2. Restart the Archipelago Launcher if it was open

## Creating your YAML

Your YAML has the settings of your game. You can make one with `Options Creator` in the Archipelago Launcher, or edit the template from `Generate Template Options`.

The [Archipelago setup guide](https://archipelago.gg/tutorial/Archipelago/setup_en) explains how to generate and host a game.

## Patching the game

1. In the Archipelago Launcher, open `SteamWorld Dig 2 Client`
2. Type `/auto_patch`. It finds the install by itself, or you can give it the game's folder: `/auto_patch <directory>`

This makes a patched copy in your Archipelago folder and leaves your normal install alone.

Run `/auto_patch` again whenever you update the apworld.

## Joining a MultiWorld Game

1. Type `/launch` in the client to start the patched copy
2. Connect the client to your room
3. Start a New Game

## Linux

1. Get the Windows version:
    - **Steam:** In the game's Properties -> Compatibility, check `Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool`.
    - **GOG:** Install the Windows version.
2. Follow [Installation](#installation) and [Patching the game](#patching-the-game).
3. Set up the patched copy's `Dig2.exe` in the launcher you want to use:
    - **Steam:** Add it as a Non-Steam game. In its Properties:
        - Compatibility: check `Force the use of a specific Steam Play compatibility tool`.
        - Launch Options: `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b" %command%`
    - **Anything else:** Run it through Wine with `WINEDLLOVERRIDES="version=n,b"` set.
4. Start the game from that launcher
5. Connect the client to your room and start a New Game

## Saves

**The patched copy shares its save slots with the normal game. Never open an Archipelago save in the normal game, and
never open a normal save in the patched copy.**

If this happens, close the game and restore `savegame_00N.dat.backup` before playing on. You'll find it here:

- **Steam:** `Documents\My Games\SteamWorld Dig 2\<a number>`
- **GOG:** `Documents\My Games\SteamWorld Dig 2`

## Client commands

- `/auto_patch <directory>` - Makes the patched copy
- `/launch` - Starts the patched copy
- `/deathlink` - Turns DeathLink on or off until the client closes

## Troubleshooting

- You get the "version.dll is missing or can't be read" error.
    - Make sure that your antivirus didn't delete any files. Add your `Archipelago` install to the exclusions and restore
      any affected items.
    - **Windows Defender:**
        - Virus & threat protection settings -> Manage settings -> Exclusions -> Add your `Archipelago` install.
        - Virus & threat protection -> Protection history -> Restore any deleted files.
    - Then run `/auto_patch` again if the error is still there.
- `/auto_patch` says the folder "exists but was not made by this client".
    - This usually means an earlier `/auto_patch` was cut off. Delete the folder and run `/auto_patch` again.

readme.text:
# SteamWorld Dig 2 Archipelago

An [Archipelago](https://archipelago.gg) implementation for SteamWorld Dig 2

## Info
- [Game Info](swd2/docs/en_SteamWorld%20Dig%202.md)
- [Setup Guide](swd2/docs/setup_en.md)
- [Releases](https://github.com/ClTYOFEVlL/SWD2-Archipelago/releases)
- [Discord Thread](https://discord.com/channels/731205301247803413/1274029361661739174)

## Credits

- Thanks to [SWD2Randomizer](https://github.com/clementgallet/SWD2Randomizer) by clementgallet. Its logic was used as a reference and some game fixes follow it

notes.text:
## New
- **Generators are now locations**, and the Reactor door needs their Device items. `Generators Required` sets all 4 (default) or the vanilla 3
- **Orbsanity option**: Orb containers as locations (85)
- **Secretsanity option**: Secret Areas (85) and Mini Secrets (35) as locations
- **Added Traps**. Trap Link included!
  - Leaky Tank Trap: Empties your water tank
  - Darkness Trap: Empties your lamp
  - Gravity Trap: Increases your gravity
  - Freeze Trap: Stops you from moving
  - Cutscene Trap: Makes Dorothy talk to herself about random things
- **Tool item options**
  - Pressure Bomb, Jackhammer and Jet Engine: All progressive, or a main item you need before the upgrades work
  - Hook Shot and Grenades: Progressive, or both tiers as individual items
- **Progressive Mobility option**: Combines the Hook and Jet items into one progressive item
- Vectron is now skipped, freeing the Jet Engine podium of its past plando-y ways. It can hold any item now
- The opening cutscene is now skipped
- Banners in game when you connect or disconnect
- Tracker tab in the client when Universal Tracker is installed

## Logic
- Yarrow and Sludge River Bend no longer need the Jet
- Temple of the Destroyer - Boss Entrance: the Cog Container and Secret Area now take the Hook or Armor (previously Armor only)

## Changed
- "Hub" areas are now called "Oasis"
- `teleporter_locations` is now `teleportersanity`
- `hell_cave_locations` is now `include_trials`

## Fixed
- `/auto_patch` now only takes the files it needs from the game, preventing any weird file shenanigans
